items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: And the first bands I heard was the old Onward Band, the Excelsior Band, and Papa Celestan's Tuxedo Band

ctx.x: That's right. They had one here.

That's right. Oh, they had more then. Yeah, it was on a Monday. See, the parade was on a Monday and the picnic was that night at the fairgrounds. And the first bands I heard was the old Onward Band, the Excelsior Band, and Papa Celestan's Tuxedo Band, which at that time it was Ridgely's Tuxedo Band. Oh, yeah. Bebe Ridgely's Tuxedo Band.
